fieldValues.title: Should minutes reuse the governance decision type?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the minutes package, which defines its own decision record in the group's eight-part form. No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. Depend on com.mudemocracy.governance and write governance/decision records.
- B. Keep a minutes-local draft decision, as the prototype: self-contained, no dependency.
- C. Draft locally, and map to governance/decision when the group's process takes it up.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether a package dependency installs as cleanly from a bundle as a single package; how the two field sets map.
fieldValues.next_action: Try the bundle with a governance dependency.
